reviewed_work: Implement the frozen auth refresh/expiry, supported signing, assurance provenance, step-up and scoped replay rules. Reconcile logical retry with fresh signed envelopes. Advertise only available authentication methods and validate correlated responses before they reach waiters.
reviewed_verify: Expired/revoked principals, signature replay, wrong session/connection replies, assurance downgrade and invalid step-up fail consistently. Same authorized operation can be recovered without bypassing anti-replay checks.
scope: Reusable canonical authentication semantics in rvoip. Shared Connect installation, independent conformance and acceptance remain assigned later.

groups.task_owned_behavior: Four-envelope signed authentication, trusted Identity/Device, finite credential binding, own-token keepalive, refresh and logout.
groups.remaining_shared_scope: The handshake token is not a reconnect/resumption grant. Conversation Participant creation and real Connect policy installation belong to G6-037/G6-038; enrollment and safe resume retain G6-055/G6-052.

groups.task_owned_behavior: Trusted transport-backed reachability registration/renewal, independently owned Devices/routes and current authorized local delivery submission.
groups.remaining_shared_scope: IdentityProvider/EndpointRuntime projection, actual invitation selection/acceptance and service business effects remain G6-037/G6-038. Hints and local admission are not a delivered/ready fact.

groups.task_owned_behavior: The approved connect/2 profile discovers only installed credential methods; unknown methods never fall back. The identified floor is explicit.
groups.remaining_shared_scope: Other credential methods are conditional and are not advertised by the current bearer installation. ES256/EdDSA are signature algorithms, not new credential methods.

groups.task_owned_behavior: Selected inline envelope signing on the canonical substrates, including actual TLS QUIC/WT/WSS signed exchanges.
groups.remaining_shared_scope: HTTP-header RFC 9421 signing is a MAY alternative and is not installed/advertised in this profile; the inline variant is selected. No claim of HTTP-header processing.

groups.task_owned_behavior: Current exact principal-owned key verification is separate from assurance promotion; only a verified correlated step-up installs higher assurance.
groups.remaining_shared_scope: Application resource permissions remain required even after signature and assurance checks.

groups.task_owned_behavior: Inline signature shape and JCS of every original field except the signature itself, including optional fields and reply correlation.
groups.remaining_shared_scope: The approved version-2 profile replaces version-1 example spellings; full independent client conformance remains G6-094.

groups.task_owned_behavior: Required EdDSA and recommended ES256 implemented in signer and all verifier entry points; ES256 is fixed-width JWA P-256/SHA-256, not DER.
groups.remaining_shared_scope: PS256/RS256 are MAY and are neither implemented nor advertised. Resolvers still enforce exact current owner/key/allowed algorithm.

groups.task_owned_behavior: Atomic shared replay and bounded freshness plus non-evicting physical lifetime retention across auth/refresh/step-up and all managed routes.
groups.remaining_shared_scope: A transport reconnect authenticates a new physical binding/new Connection; it cannot inherit the old managed route. Durable logical Session/operation identity and restart resume are G6-037/G6-052. This does not assert a physical replay fence survives restart.

groups.task_owned_behavior: Fail-closed signature/freshness/replay failures with the approved bounded v2 error taxonomy; current profile requires inline signatures.
groups.remaining_shared_scope: Unknown key and invalid cryptography have the same public problem; current profile is stricter than optional baseline signing. No credential/key/body echo.

groups.task_owned_behavior: One canonical secure command/reply gate on QUIC/WT/WSS, exact reply family/CID/SID/Connection/operation scope, bounded floors/quotas/deadlines and physical cancellation.
groups.remaining_shared_scope: Actual Connect actor assertion normalization/service dispatch is G6-037; full negotiated media and controller credential rebinding remain G6-020. Legacy-permissive behavior is excluded from connect/2, not a fallback.

groups.task_owned_behavior: Verified assurance gradient, explicit identified authentication floor, exact task/user provenance, per-mutation assurance requirement and forbidden refresh downgrade.
groups.remaining_shared_scope: The deployment may reject lower assurance; it now advertises that floor. A label/role/capability is not a grant. Connect resource-policy installation is G6-037.

groups.task_owned_behavior: Authentication retains trusted separate Identity/Device binding and physical generation; it never fabricates a conversation-scoped Participant from hello metadata.
groups.remaining_shared_scope: Actual participant creation/projection on joining a Conversation is G6-037/G6-038, using the G6-017/G6-031 relationships and current store policy.

groups.task_owned_behavior: Current/candidate/successor assurance transitions, verified step-up observation and signed factual terminal transition on credential/delegation expiry or revocation.
groups.remaining_shared_scope: Terminal anonymous closes the authenticated physical binding and grants nothing. A failed writer cannot guarantee remote notification delivery or establish a business outcome.

groups.task_owned_behavior: Exact correlated one-use bounded challenge/response and held original mutation, current old/new authority, requirement recheck, preserved logical ID/revision and truthful cancellation/failure outcomes.
groups.remaining_shared_scope: The reusable engine resumes only the original verified intent once; durable application effects/recovery remain G6-037, using the G6-035 ledger. Its local one-effect set is not a durable-restart claim.
